signs_and_coordinates: Build a finite-inertia dual-arm robot with two seven-revolute-joint arms and genuine closed-loop torque actuation.

Both arms must execute a coordinated point-to-point motion under a shared payload-equivalent load, respect finite joint-torque limits, remain stable, and recover after a temporary external joint load.

Across the declared ranges, both measured end effectors must reach the poses implied by their requested joint targets, the two arms must remain synchronized during the coordinated move, and the mechanism must settle after both the move and the temporary load.
feedback_and_control_causality: Build a finite-inertia dual-arm robot with two seven-revolute-joint arms and genuine closed-loop torque actuation.
Logs must arise from the causal closed-loop plant rather than copied commands or precomputed output trajectories.
